summary: Purpose: repair toolchain orchestration without stale-context/transport hard gates; preserve authority ownership; never auto-publish Knowledge. TWR-W0 typed source selection (consumer/policy/module/resource-set/authority/path IDs), canonical independently verifiable selection identity, fail closed on omission/ambiguity/authority drift. TWR-W1 adapter owns deterministic chunking/pagination/continuations/retries; continuation binds selection and source identity; reject stale/conflicting continuation. TWR-W2 adapter proves byte/line/hash coverage; fail or refresh on gaps, conflicting overlap, source changes; model summaries cannot complete reads. TWR-W3 separate execution/publication/review gates; allow verified degraded successor for unchanged semantics; block invalid LKG, selection/authority drift, missing sources, publication-integrity failure; no automatic Knowledge publication or Bootstrap. TWR-W4 validator/coordinator owns immutable receipts in versioned generations; bind candidate/contract/registry/authority envelope/Skill-input receipt/Knowledge freeze/validator; current pointer advances only after validation; resolve via typed pointer. TWR-W5 attempts under .skill-input-work/<plan-id>/<attempt-id>/ with lifecycle and active lease/heartbeat; retain protected references; dry-run reports, apply needs maintainer approval and non-authorizing cleanup receipt. TWR-W6 non-authorizing end-to-end test covers all gates, pointer publication, retention; invalid artifact cannot advance pointer. Ownership: VDD draft/plan-ready; Maintainer implementation authorization; Quick Dev implementation-complete; Acceptance acceptance-passed.
